repos.description: An MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27.x, featuring region-code tweaks, device presets, backups.

repos.name: krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor
repos.description: Show the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows 10/11 taskbar. Lightweight tray app, no vendor software needed. Supports Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, PS4/PS5 DualSense, Xbox and Bluetooth devices.

repos.name: erkamyaman/rust-anything
repos.description: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.

repos.name: jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm
repos.description: Run your own Switch games natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: game code rewritten to ARM64, graphics direct to Metal, one app for the whole library. Bring your own games and keys. 把你自己的 Switch 游戏原生带到 iPhone / iPad / Mac。

repos.name: ersinkoc/phonebox
repos.description: Turn an old Android phone into a customizable desk panel and touch control deck for Windows, Linux and macOS. 124 widgets and 30 templates for system stats, AI coding, media and automation, in 12 languages. USB or paired Wi-Fi. No cloud required.
